title: 第7章 食堂夜话第8章 第二个月的挥剑
content_zh:
李青跑掉之后，杂役院安静了一整天。
不是寻常的安静，是那种风暴来临前特有的、令人窒息的沉默。
杂役院的弟子们三三两两地聚在一起，窃窃私语，目光时不时瞟向食堂方向，又飞快地缩回去，像是怕烫到眼睛。
朱八斗的饕餮灵体暴露了。
这个消息像长了翅膀，不到半天就传遍了整个苍穹剑宗的外门。
据说李青连滚带爬地跑回外门弟子住处时，裤子都是湿的，一边跑一边喊“饕餮““怪物““杂役院有怪物“，声音凄厉得像是被鬼追了魂。
顾渊没有出门。他在茅草屋里躺了一天。
肋骨的伤需要静养。
他躺在稻草床上，盯着屋顶那个漏光的小洞，看着阳光从洞里慢慢移到墙角，再移到地上，最后消失不见。
天黑了。
门外传来脚步声。
很重，很缓，带着一种刻意的轻手轻脚——以朱八斗的体重，轻手轻脚是一件很难的事。
“睡了？“朱八斗的声音从门外传来，压得很低。
“没有。“
门被推开一条缝，朱八斗硕大的脑袋探进来，左右看了看。
“起来。“他说。
“食堂有好东西。“
顾渊撑着床板坐起来，动作牵扯到肋骨的伤处，一阵闷痛让他皱了皱眉。
他系好草鞋，拿起铁剑，跟着朱八斗走了出去。
夜已经很深了。

深秋的夜空格外清澈，星星像是被人用钉子一颗颗钉在黑色的天幕上，密密麻麻，冰冷而遥远。
一轮残月挂在西边的山脊上，散发着微弱的银光，将两个人的影子拉得很长很长。
食堂里点着一盏油灯。
灯火昏黄，在墙壁上投下摇曳的影子。
灶台上放着一个小火炉，炉子上温着一壶酒，酒香混合着烟火气，在空气中缓缓流动。
一张矮桌摆在灶台边，桌上摆着几样小菜——一碟花生米，一碟腌肉，一碟炒青菜，还有两双筷子，两个粗瓷碗。
朱八斗在矮桌旁坐下，庞大的身躯将狭小的空间占去了一大半。
他提起酒壶，给两个碗各倒了一碗。
“坐。“他用下巴指了指对面的位置。
顾渊坐了下来。
油灯的光芒在他脸上跳动，将他的轮廓照得忽明忽暗。
朱八斗端起酒碗，一口气喝了半碗，然后长长地出了一口气。
他的脸在灯光下显得格外庞大，油汗从额头上渗出来，在鬓角处闪着光。
“白天的事。“他开口，声音有些沙哑。
“你没什么想问的？“
顾渊端起酒碗，没有喝，只是看着碗中晃动的酒液。
“有。“
“问。“
“你为什么在杂役院？“
content_en:
After Li Qing ran away, the courtyard was quiet for a whole day.
It's not ordinary silence, it's the unique, suffocating silence before the storm.
The disciples in the courtyard gathered together in twos and threes, whispering, and glanced in the direction of the cafeteria from time to time, then quickly retracted, as if they were afraid of burning their eyes.
Zhu Badou's Taotie spirit body was exposed.
This news seemed to have grown wings, and in less than half a day it spread throughout the entire outer sect of the Cang Qiong Sword Sect.
It is said that when Li Qing crawled on the ground and ran back to the residence of the outer disciples, his pants were all wet. As he ran, he shouted "Taotie", "Monster", "There is a monster in the courtyard", his voice was shrill and shrill as if he was being chased by a ghost.
Gu Yuan did not go out. He lay in the thatched hut all day.
The rib injury requires rest.
He lay on the straw bed, staring at the small hole in the roof that leaked light, watching the sunlight slowly move from the hole to the corner of the wall, then to the ground, and finally disappeared.
It's dark.
There were footsteps outside the door.
Very heavy, very slow, with a kind of deliberate lightness - with Zhu Badou's weight, lightness is a very difficult thing to do.
"Asleep?" Zhu Badou's voice came from outside the door, very low.
"No."
The door was pushed open a crack, and Zhu Badou's huge head poked in, looking around.
"Get up." he said.
“There’s good stuff in the cafeteria.”
Gu Yuan sat up, holding on to the bed board. The movement involved the injury to his ribs, and he frowned due to a dull pain.
He tied up his straw sandals, picked up the iron sword, and followed Zhu Badou out.
The night is already very deep.
The night sky in late autumn is exceptionally clear, and the stars seem to have been nailed to the black sky one by one, densely packed, cold and distant.
A waning moon hung on the ridge to the west, emitting a faint silver light that stretched the shadows of the two people very long.
An oil lamp was lit in the dining hall.
The lights were dim, casting swaying shadows on the walls.
There was a small stove on the stove, and a pot of wine was warming on the stove. The aroma of the wine mixed with the smoke of smoke flowed slowly in the air.
A low table was placed next to the stove. There were several side dishes on the table - a plate of peanuts, a plate of marinated meat, a plate of fried vegetables, two pairs of chopsticks, and two coarse porcelain bowls.
Zhu Badou sat down at the low table, his huge body taking up more than half of the small space.
He lifted the jug and poured a bowl into each of the two bowls.
"Sit." He pointed to the opposite position with his chin.
Gu Yuan sat down.
The light of the oil lamp danced on his face, illuminating his outline in and out.
Zhu Badou picked up the wine bowl, drank half of it in one breath, and then let out a long breath.
His face looked extraordinarily huge under the light, and oily sweat seeped out from his forehead, glistening on his temples.
"It was during the day." He said, his voice a little hoarse.
"You don't have anything to ask?"
Gu Yuan picked up the wine bowl, but did not drink. He just looked at the wine sloshing in the bowl.
"Yes."
"Ask."
"Why are you in the yard?"
